ModMetaData.name: Insectomorph Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Insectomorph art (south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 fauna/flora sitting: total art redo for this SW canon creature (native to Malastare), same treatment as Kreetle/Horax/Fambaa/Dragonsnake/Zakkeg. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Insectomorph/Insectomorph_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
Same donor as ART_REGEN_WAVE1_WIRE_IN_1's five overrides: the loose-PNG-over- AssetBundle mechanism was already proven live for mlie.starwarsanimalcollection on RimWorld 1.6.4871 (2026-09-11) - not re-proven here, only spot-checked.
